description: Source code for LED control plugin implementing JSON-RPC methods to get supported LED states, get current LED state, and set LED state, including platform initialization and deinitialization.

classes.name: LEDControl
classes.description: Main class implementing LED control plugin with JSON-RPC methods and platform management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes platform resources if not already initialized.

methods.name: getSupportedLEDStates
methods.description: Returns all supported LED states supported by the platform.

methods.name: getLEDState
methods.description: Returns current LED state of the platform.

methods.name: setLEDState
methods.description: Sets the LED state to the specified value.
